description: This file contains utility functions related to GraphQL selection processing, validation, serialization, and comparison for form fields within a React application, specifically for admin UI components in a KeystoneJS project.

methods.name: extractRootFields
methods.description: Recursively extracts root graphQL field names from a selection set.

methods.name: getRootGraphQLFieldsFromFieldController
methods.description: Generates a list of root GraphQL fields used in a fragment based on a field controller.

methods.name: useInvalidFields
methods.description: React hook that returns a set of invalid fields based on validation logic.

methods.name: makeDefaultValueState
methods.description: Creates an initial default value state object for form fields.

methods.name: deserializeItemToValue
methods.description: Deserializes an item object into a form-ready value object based on field metadata.

methods.name: serializeValueToOperationItem
methods.description: Serializes form values into an operation object suitable for create/update mutations.

methods.name: useHasChanges
methods.description: React hook to determine if form values have changes compared to a reference state.
